**The description you submitted**

Paste it verbatim. The verdict is a function of these exact words.

**Permalink**

The `/v/<hash>` URL, if you have one. It carries every answer.

**What it said, and what it should have said**

<!-- e.g. "Just write code", but this needs a judgment about what the text
     means, so it should be "Jev fits". -->

**Which judgment looks wrong**

Open *Show your work* and name the question. A verdict is composed in code from
nineteen answers, so a wrong verdict is usually one wrong answer or one
mis-weighted band — naming it is most of the fix.
